requirements.title: Pointer association status is associated, disassociated, or undefined with specified initialization states
requirements.definition: A pointer has association status associated, disassociated, or undefined; status may change during execution. Unless initialized explicitly or by default, initial status is undefined. A pointer may be initialized disassociated or associated.

pending.association-status-three-states: Source-control matrix records associated and disassociated observations with ASSOCIATED; undefined status is listed but never inspected.
pending.association-status-changes: Start p=>a with a=1, observe ASSOCIATED(p,a) true; then NULLIFY(p) and observe ASSOCIATED(p) false; then p=>b with b=2 and observe true plus exact p=2.
pending.uninitialized-pointer-status-undefined-n: No portable runtime oracle observes the initial undefined status of an uninitialized pointer; future code immediately initializes before inquiry.
pending.initialized-disassociated-status: integer, pointer :: p=>null(); first operation is ASSOCIATED(p) into logical sentinel .true.; expected result is .false. after explicit disassociated initialization.
pending.initialized-associated-status: Module target integer t=42 and pointer p=>t; first operation observes ASSOCIATED(p,t) true and p exact 42.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future fixtures establish a distinguished non-default state first, then observe only portable single-image properties: exact integer, logical, character, type, rank, bounds, ASSOCIATED inquiry results for defined pointer association status, or required syntax diagnostics owned by a numbered rule. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are never inspected, dereferenced, invoked, compared, or passed to ASSOCIATED as an oracle.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Unnumbered program restrictions are source-control restrictions only. Notes are informative. Coarray, image, team, companion-processor lifetime, volatile-interference, addresses, diagnostic wording, exit status details, and processor-dependent representations are not asserted.
